description: Use this when someone asks how large a CLP hazard label, its pictograms or its font must be for a given pack size, e.g. "label size for a 750 ml bottle". Returns the label size, pictogram size and minimum font size (x-height) for a pack size under section 1.2.1.4 of Annex I to the CLP Regulation as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/2865, next to the value in the Omnibus text that is not yet law, with the date the values were last checked. Do not use for what text the label must carry (use search_knowledge) or for labels outside CLP.

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German, default), "en" (English) or "pl" (Polish). Product and account answers are written in German and English; content without a translation comes in German.

volume_ml.description: Capacity of the package in millilitres, e.g. 750

name: clp_label_dimensions
title: CLP label and pictogram sizes
